item.title: Prosecutor awaits investigation report in shooting death of 14-year-old
item.description: The Muskegon County Prosecutor's Office is awaiting the results of a Michigan State Police investigation into the shooting and death of a 14-year-old in Fruitport Township.

item.title: DNR: Confirmed cougar sightings in Michigan have doubled over last 3 years
item.description: The latest data from the DNR shows confirmed cougar sightings surged in 2025, the latest sign that cougars once again live in the state.

item.title: Court documents: Triple murder suspect made up story about armed strangers before confessing
item.description: When police responded to his tearful 911 call about a shooting Tuesday morning, Charles Broomfield told them that two men had broken in and killed his fiancée and her two sons, according to court documents. A short time later, after police found inconsistencies in his story, Broomfield confessed to killing his fiancée Jacqueline Neill, 40, and her sons, Michael Kilpatrick, 13, and Cameron Kilpatrick, 15, according to court documents.

item.title: Patrick Kane passes Mike Modano for the most NHL points by a US-born player
item.description: Kane became the highest-scoring United States-born player in NHL history, passing Mike Modano with an assist for his 1,375th point on an assist Thursday night for the Detroit Red Wings against the Washington Capitals.
